sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL Mr. Shobhit Tiwari for the petitioner.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar Sharma, GC for the respondents.

The petitioner has sought a direction to the respondents to not adopt pick and choose method while sending the candidates for Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Training for three months as provided in the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and Rules made thereunder.
He has sought a further direction that he be deputed for training.
Learned counsel for the respondents submits that the aforementioned training was discontinued after the enforcement of new Rules w.e.f. 2010 framed under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Therefore, as the training which has been sought by the petitioner has been discontinued by the respondents, the instant petition would not require any adjudication.
Consequently, the writ petition is disposed of as infructuous.

(ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL),J.
